name: @educateos/lti-district
description: The district side of EducateOS's LTI integration: the broker's stores (login state, deep linking sessions, registrations, pending dynamic registrations, the passback ledger, context services, grade routes and columns) over one keyed record table, with a Durable Object SQLite table at `./durable-object`; NRPS roster projections applied through AcademicSync; teacher approvals read from E01 official grade versions; and the policy-authorized admin service that approves registrations and builds grade routes. A library, not a deployable Worker.
